shared_schema.input: Strict JSON envelope: schema_version, synthetic=true, patient_record, clinical_notes, prior_authorization_requests, catalog, preferences. See example_input.json for the complete field contract.
shared_schema.resources: FHIR-style Patient, DocumentReference clinical note text, and draft Claim with use=preauthorization. Synthetic pseudonym IDs only; no real names, birth dates or MRNs.
shared_schema.output: CLI status=ok and data retaining the complete input envelope plus discovery, research and audit_trail. Errors are one status=error JSON object, exit 2, without echoing sensitive input.
shared_schema.validation: One validate(document, phase) layer validates input, discovery handoff and final output. Unknown fields, PHI keys/patterns, malformed values, duplicate resource IDs, foreign patient references and unsafe categories/statuses are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Validated discovery records carry product ID, patient reference, score, matched tags and query terms. Research consumes only those selected recommendations and the shared clinical-note/authorization sources. Tampered discovery output is rejected.

behavior.personalized_discovery: Reusable tag matching: interest=3, otherwise diagnosis=2, otherwise lab-code=1; an authorization tag adds 2 when draft requests exist. Rank descending score, then ascending product ID; return at most preferences.limit (1..10). Zero-match products provide deterministic fallback, not a clinical recommendation.
behavior.normal_research: Rank source passages by number of distinct overlapping query tokens; ties use source ID then source character offset. Return up to two positive-match passages per recommendation. Findings equal exact quotes with source_id and end-exclusive Python Unicode start/end offsets. Missing evidence yields no findings.
behavior.safety: Only administrative-support and education products. Human review required on clinical resources and all generated records; autonomous_clinical_decision=false. Authorization remains draft. No treatment, eligibility or coverage decisions.
behavior.audit: Inputs are immutable and returned unchanged. Every newly created recommendation and finding has an ordered create event with stage, actor, record ID, null prior hash and SHA-256 of canonical output record. No update/delete API exists. Deterministic sequence numbers replace wall-clock timestamps.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: Clearly labeled fictitious Synthea-style condition and lab data; not an actual Synthea export.
behavior.deidentification: Demonstrative strict synthetic-data admission with direct identifier field rejection and selected free-text identifier pattern checks. Does not implement all HIPAA Safe Harbor categories or certify arbitrary text as deidentified.

test_outcomes.cli: passed: exit 0, one JSON object with status=ok
test_outcomes.validation_errors: Covered: exit 2, one JSON object with status=error
